ModMetaData.name: Dyze's Pathogenics
ModMetaData.author: Dyze
ModMetaData.description:
Dyze's Pathogenics is a RimWorld mod focused on disease simulation instead of random one-off illness events.
The current v0.2 slice adds the foundation for a standalone respiratory disease.
Included in this slice: - hidden disease state before symptoms appear - a visible standalone disease for testing - debug actions to expose a pawn, inspect state, clear state, and force symptom onset
Not included yet: - proximity transmission - exposure accumulation - richer player feedback - quarantine tools - additional disease types
